description: Refine an earlier search_providers or research_capability answer with a correction, and get a better answer back in the same call. Pass the request_ref returned with that answer and the correction in plain words: what was missing or wrong (e.g. 'I meant apps that reduce business costs', 'must integrate with Slack', 'budget is $20/month', 'data must stay in the EU'). Agentery re-reads the request with the correction (changed constraints change, the others are kept), runs the search again and returns the new answer plus a short explanation of what changed. Optional: source = 'human' (the user's own words), 'agent' (your own assessment) or 'follow_up' (an ordinary narrowing, not a complaint). A message with nothing actionable (e.g. 'thanks') is just acknowledged. Agentery only sees the request and correction you send, never your wider conversation.

correction.description: What was missing or wrong, in plain words.

request_ref.description: The request_ref from the earlier answer (rq_ + 12 hex characters).

source.description: Where the correction came from. Default 'agent'.

name: refine_results
